name: Passing of Judgment (In Effect)
description:
After you play an Event Card this Round: Grant Invalidation to all Event Cards in your Hand.
After you Discard from your Hand in this Round: Place 2 cards in your Hand with the highest Current Elemental Dice Cost to the bottom of your deck.
